This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, round [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and elongated [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. One member of this species was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]<ref name="Dark Times" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Intro">The date of [[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnidentifiedSpecies-SangJunLee-TaoRotS.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Original concept art by Sang Jun Lee]]
This species was first designed by concept artist [[Sang Jun Lee]] for the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], though the concepts would go unused,<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> later recycled in [[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]] illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]]<ref name="Dark Times" /> and published on [[May 9]], [[2007]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54077/star_wars_dark_times_2006_3|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #3}}</ref>
